capabilities.title: Soil model from a borehole log
capabilities.prompt: Build the soil model from the attached borehole log: one borehole per log, the layers with their top and bottom levels, and a material for each layer. List the layers you read, with any value you estimated marked as estimated, before you build.

capabilities.title: Several boreholes from a site investigation
capabilities.prompt: Read the attached site investigation report and create every borehole in it at its coordinates, with the layers and the water level of each. Show me a table of the boreholes and layers first.

capabilities.title: Soil parameters from the report
capabilities.prompt: Work out the parameters of each soil layer from the attached report (unit weights, strength, stiffness, permeability), choose a suitable material model for each, and show them in a table with the source of every value before you create the materials.

capabilities.title: Add a borehole
capabilities.prompt: Add a borehole at x = [x] m with the same layers as {borehole}, and tell me which layer levels I should adjust.

capabilities.title: Change a material's parameters
capabilities.prompt: Show me the parameters of {material} in a table, then change the ones I tell you. Change nothing before I answer.

capabilities.title: Switch a layer to Hardening Soil small
capabilities.prompt: Change {material} from Mohr-Coulomb to Hardening Soil small. Work out E50, Eoed, Eur, G0 and gamma 0.7 from what the project and my notes give, show them with how you got each, and wait for my yes.

capabilities.title: Drained or undrained
capabilities.prompt: List every soil material with its drainage type, and tell me which ones look wrong for the kind of soil and the kind of analysis.

capabilities.title: Water levels
capabilities.prompt: Show the groundwater head of every borehole and the water conditions of every phase in one table, and point out anything inconsistent.

capabilities.title: Compare materials with the report
capabilities.prompt: Compare every soil material in the project with the attached geotechnical report and list the parameters that differ, with both values.

capabilities.title: Retaining wall with anchors
capabilities.prompt: Draw a retaining wall as a plate from level [top] to level [toe] at x = [x] m, with interfaces on both sides and one row of anchors at level [level]. Tell me the plate and anchor materials you will use first.

capabilities.title: Plate material from a section
capabilities.prompt: Create a plate material for a [sheet pile or diaphragm wall] section: work out EA, EI and weight per metre of wall from the section I give you, and show the numbers before you create it.

capabilities.title: Anchors and struts
capabilities.prompt: List every anchor and strut with its level, spacing, stiffness and prestress, and tell me which phases activate each.

capabilities.title: Embedded piles
capabilities.prompt: Add a row of embedded beam piles at the spacing and length I give you, with a pile material worked out from the diameter and concrete grade. Show the material first.

capabilities.title: Interfaces
capabilities.prompt: List every interface with its strength reduction and the material it takes it from, and tell me where a wall or pile has none.

capabilities.title: Surface loads
capabilities.prompt: Add a surface load of [value] kN/m2 from x = [from] to x = [to] m at ground level, and tell me which phase should activate it.

capabilities.title: Structures summary
capabilities.prompt: List every structure in the model (plates, anchors, geogrids, embedded beams, interfaces, loads) with its material and where it is.

capabilities.title: Generate the mesh
capabilities.prompt: Generate the mesh at medium coarseness, tell me the number of elements and nodes, and say whether anything looks too coarse near the wall.

capabilities.title: Refine around the wall
capabilities.prompt: Refine the mesh around the wall and the excavation, generate it again, and tell me how the element count changed.

capabilities.title: Mesh sensitivity
capabilities.prompt: Run the calculation with the current mesh and with one step finer, and compare the maximum wall deflection and bending moment so I can see whether the mesh is fine enough.

capabilities.title: Mesh quality
capabilities.prompt: Check the mesh for badly shaped elements and tell me where they are and what to change in the geometry to remove them.

capabilities.title: Set up the construction phases
capabilities.prompt: Set up the construction phases for this model in order (initial phase, wall installation, each excavation level, each anchor row, final level), and tell me what is active in each before you calculate.

capabilities.title: Add an excavation stage
capabilities.prompt: Add a phase after {phase} that excavates to level [level] and lowers the water inside the excavation to the same level. Tell me what it deactivates.

capabilities.title: Add a safety phase
capabilities.prompt: Add a safety (phi-c reduction) phase after {phase} and tell me its settings.

capabilities.title: Phase overview
capabilities.prompt: List every phase with its previous phase, calculation type, what it activates and deactivates, and whether it is calculated.

capabilities.title: Check the staging logic
capabilities.prompt: Go through the phases in order and tell me anything that looks wrong: an anchor prestressed before it is installed, soil excavated below the water without dewatering, a load active too early, a phase after the wrong one.

capabilities.title: Consolidation phase
capabilities.prompt: Add a consolidation phase after {phase} for [days] days, and tell me the settings you used.

capabilities.title: Rename the phases
capabilities.prompt: Rename the phases so each name says what it does ("Excavate to -4.0 m", "Install anchor row 1"). Show me the old and new names first.

capabilities.title: Calculate and say how it went
capabilities.prompt: Calculate every phase one at a time, saving after each, and tell me how each one ended.

capabilities.title: Calculate only what changed
capabilities.prompt: Calculate only the phases that are marked to be calculated, one at a time, and tell me how each ended.

capabilities.title: Why did this phase fail?
capabilities.prompt: {phase} failed. Read its log and the results up to the last step, and tell me the most likely reason and the one change you would try first. Change nothing yet.

capabilities.title: Long run overnight
capabilities.prompt: Calculate all the phases one by one tonight, saving after each and keeping the files small. If a phase fails, stop there and tell me in the morning what ended and what did not.

capabilities.title: Numerical settings
capabilities.prompt: Show the numerical control parameters of {phase} (tolerated error, max steps, arc-length, max load fraction) and tell me which I should change for a soil body near failure.

capabilities.title: Wall deflection and forces
capabilities.prompt: Give me the maximum horizontal displacement, bending moment and shear force of the wall in {phase}, with where along the wall each occurs.

capabilities.title: Anchor and strut forces
capabilities.prompt: Give me the force in every anchor and strut for every calculated phase, in one table, with the largest of each.

capabilities.title: Settlement behind the wall
capabilities.prompt: Give me the settlement of the ground surface behind the wall in {phase}: the maximum, where it is, and the values every 5 m.

capabilities.title: Safety factor
capabilities.prompt: Give me the factor of safety of every safety phase, and describe the failure mechanism of the lowest one.

capabilities.title: Compare phases
capabilities.prompt: Compare the wall deflection and bending moment across all calculated phases in one table, so I can see which phase governs.

capabilities.title: Results at a point
capabilities.prompt: Give me the displacement, total stress, effective stress and pore pressure at the point I name, for every calculated phase.

capabilities.title: Pile and plate envelopes
capabilities.prompt: Give me the envelope (maximum and minimum over all phases) of axial force, shear force and bending moment for every plate and embedded beam.

capabilities.title: Results into Excel
capabilities.prompt: Put the wall deflection, bending moments and anchor forces of every calculated phase into one Excel file beside the project, one sheet per result, with the governing values on a summary sheet.

capabilities.title: Calculation report in Word
capabilities.prompt: Write a calculation report in Word for this project: the soil model and parameters, the structures, the phases, the governing results per phase and the safety factors. Ask me for the title and project number first.

capabilities.title: Soil parameters table
capabilities.prompt: Make an Excel table of every soil material with its model and parameters, ready to paste into the design basis.

capabilities.title: Summary slides
capabilities.prompt: Make a short PowerPoint for the design review: the section, the soil model, the phases, and the governing deflection, moment, anchor force and safety factor.

capabilities.title: Section as DXF
capabilities.prompt: Draw the model's section as a DXF: the soil layers, the wall, the anchors and the excavation levels, to scale in the project's units.

capabilities.title: Report in the office's style
capabilities.prompt: Read the two earlier reports I attach, then write this project's report in the same structure and wording.

capabilities.title: Review the model
capabilities.prompt: Review this model as a checker would: units, soil model and parameters, water, interfaces, mesh, phases and numerical settings. List what you would question, the most serious first. Change nothing.

capabilities.title: Model against the design basis
capabilities.prompt: Compare the model with the attached design basis (levels, loads, soil parameters, water levels, stages) and list every difference with both values.

capabilities.title: Model against the drawing
capabilities.prompt: Read the attached section drawing (DXF or PDF) and compare its levels and dimensions with the model. List what differs.

capabilities.title: What is in this project?
capabilities.prompt: Tell me what is in this project in a few lines: 2D or 3D, units, the soil layers, the structures, the phases and which of them are calculated.

capabilities.title: Before I send it out
capabilities.prompt: Check that every phase is calculated and ended OK, that no phase is marked to be calculated again, and that the results I reported still match the project.

capabilities.title: Kept code
capabilities.prompt: List the code Plaxis ProMax has kept from earlier work, with what each one does, so I can ask for it again by name.

capabilities.title: A rule for every chat
capabilities.prompt: Remember this as a rule for every chat: [your rule, for example "we always use HS small for sand" or "levels are in m CD"].

capabilities.title: What did we do last time?
capabilities.prompt: Tell me what the earlier chats on this project did and what was still to do.

capabilities.title: Split it across the crew
capabilities.prompt: Read the three attached borehole logs and work out the parameters with separate jobs, while another job sets up the wall and the phases. Tell me who does what first.

capabilities.title: Nightly check
capabilities.prompt: Every night, check that the open project's phases are all calculated and OK, and tell me in the morning what changed.

tailored.title: Soil model from the logs
tailored.prompt: Build the soil model for this excavation from the attached borehole logs: boreholes, layers and a material for each layer. List what you read first, with estimates marked.

tailored.title: Wall, anchors and interfaces
tailored.prompt: Draw the retaining wall with interfaces on both sides and the anchor rows at the levels I give you, with a plate material worked out from the wall section.

tailored.title: Excavation stages
tailored.prompt: Set up the phases for a staged excavation: wall installation, then for each level excavate, dewater and install the anchor row, down to the final level. Show me the list before you add them.

tailored.title: Surcharge behind the wall
tailored.prompt: Add a surcharge of [value] kN/m2 behind the wall from the wall to [distance] m, active from the first excavation phase.

tailored.title: Dewatering
tailored.prompt: Set the water inside the excavation to follow the excavation level in each phase, and tell me how you modelled it.

tailored.title: Mesh for an excavation
tailored.prompt: Generate the mesh, refined around the wall, the anchors and the excavation base, and tell me the element count.

tailored.title: Run the stages
tailored.prompt: Calculate every phase one at a time, saving after each, and tell me how each one ended.

tailored.title: Governing wall forces
tailored.prompt: Give me the maximum deflection, bending moment and shear force of the wall for every phase, and tell me which phase governs each.

tailored.title: Anchor forces per stage
tailored.prompt: Give me the force in every anchor row for every phase, with the largest of each and the phase it occurs in.

tailored.title: Settlement of the neighbours
tailored.prompt: Give me the settlement trough behind the wall at the final stage, and the settlement and tilt at the building [distance] m away.

tailored.title: Basal stability
tailored.prompt: Add a safety phase after the final excavation, calculate it, and tell me the factor of safety and the failure mechanism.

tailored.title: What if the anchors are softer?
tailored.prompt: Copy the project's results first, then halve the anchor stiffness, recalculate, and compare the wall deflection and moments with before.

tailored.title: Check the staging
tailored.prompt: Go through the phases and tell me anything out of order: an anchor prestressed before it is installed, excavation below water without dewatering, a missing wall installation phase.

tailored.title: Check the interfaces
tailored.prompt: List the interface strength reduction for every soil against the wall, and tell me which look too high or too low for that soil.

tailored.title: Against the design basis
tailored.prompt: Compare the levels, surcharges, water levels and soil parameters of the model with the attached design basis and list the differences.

tailored.title: Embedment check
tailored.prompt: Tell me the embedded length of the wall below the final excavation level and the passive resistance that is mobilised in the last phase.

tailored.title: Mesh sensitivity
tailored.prompt: Recalculate with one step finer mesh and compare the governing deflection and moment, so I can see whether the mesh is fine enough.

tailored.title: Review as a checker
tailored.prompt: Review this excavation model as an independent checker would, and list what you would question, most serious first. Change nothing.

tailored.title: Results workbook
tailored.prompt: Put the wall deflection, bending moment, shear force and anchor forces of every phase into one Excel file, with a summary sheet of the governing values.

tailored.title: Calculation report
tailored.prompt: Write the calculation report for this excavation in Word: soil model, wall and anchors, stages, governing results per stage, settlements and safety factor.

tailored.title: Stage by stage table
tailored.prompt: Make a table with one row per phase: excavation level, water level, wall deflection, moment, anchor forces and whether it ended OK.

tailored.title: Section drawing
tailored.prompt: Draw the section as a DXF: soil layers, wall, anchors and each excavation level, to scale.

tailored.title: Review slides
tailored.prompt: Make a short PowerPoint for the design review with the section, the stages and the governing results.

tailored.title: Anchor schedule
tailored.prompt: Make an Excel schedule of the anchors: level, spacing, inclination, free and fixed length, prestress and maximum force over all phases.

tailored.title: Quay wall section
tailored.prompt: Build the soil model for this quay wall from the attached logs, with the seabed, the dredge level and the fill behind the wall as separate layers.

tailored.title: Combi wall and tie rods
tailored.prompt: Draw the combi wall as a plate with the tie rod and the anchor wall behind it, with materials worked out from the sections I give you.

tailored.title: Water levels for a quay
tailored.prompt: Set the water levels for the design cases I give you (low water in front, lagging groundwater behind the wall), and tell me how each phase uses them.

tailored.title: Quay loads
tailored.prompt: Add the crane load, the surcharge on the apron and the bollard pull as loads, and tell me which phase each is active in.

tailored.title: Construction and dredging stages
tailored.prompt: Set up the phases: existing seabed, wall installation, tie rod, backfill in lifts, dredging to design depth, then the load cases. Show me the list first.

tailored.title: Relieving platform piles
tailored.prompt: Add the piles of the relieving platform as embedded beams at the rows and rakes I give you, with a pile material from the diameter and wall thickness.

tailored.title: Run the stages
tailored.prompt: Calculate every phase one at a time, saving after each, and tell me how each one ended.

tailored.title: Wall and tie rod forces
tailored.prompt: Give me the maximum bending moment and deflection of the quay wall and the tie rod force for every phase and load case, with which case governs.

tailored.title: Overdredge case
tailored.prompt: Add a phase with [value] m of overdredge in front of the wall, calculate it, and compare the wall moment and tie rod force with the design depth.

tailored.title: Overall stability
tailored.prompt: Add a safety phase for the governing load case, calculate it, and tell me the factor of safety and whether the slip passes below the wall toe.

tailored.title: Settlement of the apron
tailored.prompt: Give me the settlement of the apron and the crane rails after backfilling and under the operating loads.

tailored.title: Pile forces
tailored.prompt: Give me the axial force, shear force and bending moment envelope of every pile row over all phases.

tailored.title: Water pressure check
tailored.prompt: Show the pore pressures on both sides of the wall for the governing case and tell me whether the water lag is what the design basis asks for.

tailored.title: Against the design basis
tailored.prompt: Compare the dredge level, water levels, loads and soil parameters of the model with the attached basis of design and list the differences.

tailored.title: Check the tie rod
tailored.prompt: Tell me the tie rod's stiffness, spacing and level, the phase it is installed in, and whether it is ever in compression.

tailored.title: Check the staging
tailored.prompt: Go through the phases and tell me anything out of order: dredging before the tie rod is in, loads before the backfill, a missing water change.

tailored.title: Toe embedment
tailored.prompt: Tell me the wall's embedment below the dredge level and the passive resistance mobilised in the governing case.

tailored.title: Review as a checker
tailored.prompt: Review this quay wall model as an independent checker would, and list what you would question, most serious first. Change nothing.

tailored.title: Results workbook
tailored.prompt: Put the wall deflection, bending moment, tie rod force and pile forces of every phase into one Excel file, with a summary of the governing values.

tailored.title: Calculation report
tailored.prompt: Write the calculation report for this quay wall in Word: soil model, structure, water levels, stages, load cases, governing results and overall stability.

tailored.title: Load case table
tailored.prompt: Make a table with one row per load case: water levels, loads, wall moment, deflection, tie rod force and factor of safety where there is one.

tailored.title: Section drawing
tailored.prompt: Draw the quay section as a DXF: soil layers, wall, tie rod, anchor wall, piles, seabed and dredge level, to scale.

tailored.title: Review slides
tailored.prompt: Make a short PowerPoint for the design review with the section, the stages, the load cases and the governing results.

tailored.title: Soil parameter table
tailored.prompt: Make an Excel table of every soil material with its model and parameters for the basis of design.

tailored.title: Soil model from the logs
tailored.prompt: Build the soil model from the attached borehole logs: boreholes, layers and a material for each layer. List what you read first, with estimates marked.

tailored.title: Raft or footing
tailored.prompt: Draw the raft as a plate at founding level with its load, with a plate material worked out from the thickness and concrete grade.

tailored.title: Embankment in lifts
tailored.prompt: Draw the embankment in the lifts I give you, with a phase for each lift and a consolidation period between them. Show me the phases first.

tailored.title: Piled raft
tailored.prompt: Add the piles under the raft as embedded beams at the spacing and length I give you, with a pile material from the diameter.

tailored.title: Soft soil parameters
tailored.prompt: Work out Soft Soil (or Soft Soil Creep) parameters for the clay from the oedometer results in the attached report, and show them with how you got each.

tailored.title: Drains and preloading
tailored.prompt: Add vertical drains at the spacing I give you under the embankment and a preload phase, and tell me how you modelled the drains.

tailored.title: Run the stages
tailored.prompt: Calculate every phase one at a time, saving after each, and tell me how each one ended.

tailored.title: Settlement
tailored.prompt: Give me the settlement under the foundation at the end of construction and at the end of consolidation, with the differential settlement across it.

tailored.title: Settlement against time
tailored.prompt: Give me the settlement of the embankment's centre against time through all phases, as a table I can plot.

tailored.title: Excess pore pressure
tailored.prompt: Give me the maximum excess pore pressure after each lift and how much has dissipated before the next one.

tailored.title: Stability of each lift
tailored.prompt: Add a safety phase after each lift, calculate them, and give me the factor of safety of each.

tailored.title: Raft and pile forces
tailored.prompt: Give me the bending moment in the raft and the axial force in every pile, with the share of the load the piles carry.

tailored.title: Drainage types
tailored.prompt: List every soil with its drainage type and permeability, and tell me which look wrong for a consolidation analysis.

tailored.title: Against the design basis
tailored.prompt: Compare the loads, levels, soil parameters and construction times of the model with the attached design basis and list the differences.

tailored.title: Check the staging
tailored.prompt: Go through the phases and tell me anything out of order: a lift without its consolidation time, a load before the structure, a wrong time interval.

tailored.title: Boundary conditions
tailored.prompt: Tell me the model's boundaries and their distance from the foundation, the flow boundary conditions, and whether they are far enough.

tailored.title: Mesh sensitivity
tailored.prompt: Recalculate with one step finer mesh and compare the settlement, so I can see whether the mesh is fine enough.

tailored.title: Review as a checker
tailored.prompt: Review this model as an independent checker would, and list what you would question, most serious first. Change nothing.

tailored.title: Results workbook
tailored.prompt: Put the settlements, excess pore pressures and safety factors of every phase into one Excel file, with a summary sheet.

tailored.title: Calculation report
tailored.prompt: Write the calculation report in Word: soil model, foundation or embankment, stages and times, settlements against time, and stability.

tailored.title: Settlement table
tailored.prompt: Make a table with one row per phase: time, fill height or load, settlement, excess pore pressure and factor of safety.

tailored.title: Section drawing
tailored.prompt: Draw the section as a DXF: soil layers, the foundation or embankment lifts, drains and piles, to scale.

tailored.title: Review slides
tailored.prompt: Make a short PowerPoint for the design review with the section, the stages and the governing results.

tailored.title: Soil parameter table
tailored.prompt: Make an Excel table of every soil material with its model and parameters for the design basis.
